pages.text: Machines can consume or produce fluids. Fluid hatches are the connection points between a multiblock and your fluid storage or pipes.$(br)$(br)Each Fluid Input Hatch and Fluid Output Hatch holds 32,000 mB (32 buckets).
The Fluid Input Hatch accepts fluid from external automation on its facing side.
The Fluid Output Hatch exposes stored output fluid for extraction on its facing side.
